How to Play

When the neighborhood goes to sleep, the Raccoon Raid begins. You and your fellow raccoons sneak from yard to yard searching for the best loot before the neighborhood wakes up. Every trip into a garbage can could uncover delicious treasures… or make enough noise to bring the humans outside. Push your luck, outsmart your friends, and make it home with the biggest haul.
